rulings.span: Make `give` and `refuse` receive a person number (or a value resolved to one before they are called) and append that number instead of the supplied name.

- Existing names may appear outside `who`: free-text `note` is copied without validation, and the current repository gives examples of a surname in a note.  The requirement says the whole book is to name no one, but the code cannot determine whether each note identifies someone.  Trustees must set a redaction policy and provide/approve review of historical and future notes; automated structural migration alone cannot guarantee this.
